nights.title: Night 4 · The Unsure Band
nights.lesson: Probabilities, thresholds and waking the manager
nights.policy: Approve late checkout when a guest asks for it. Anything else gets a normal reply. A wrong approval costs the hotel. Waking the manager is always safe, but it costs you.

q.instructions: Is the guest who wrote `message` asking to leave their room later than the normal checkout time?

criteria.true: They ask, hint or hope to stay in the room past checkout on their last day.
criteria.false: They ask about checkout times, bag storage, extra nights, or are leaving early.

nights.debrief: A probability is an interface, not an answer. Act when Jev is sure, decline when it’s sure it’s a no, and give the band in between its own row: wake the manager. Where you set the thresholds is policy, so it goes in code.
